sentences.text: Fishing charters bring their own injuries.
A fish hook in or near the eye, or deep in a joint, should be left in place, secured, and treated ashore.
Venomous spines from stingrays, catfish and lionfish cause intense pain, and soaking the wound in water as hot as the person can tolerate without burning breaks down the venom.
Rinse jellyfish stings with seawater, not fresh water, which can trigger more stinging cells.
Clean cuts from fish, shells and coral well, because warm Florida waters carry Vibrio bacteria, which can cause serious infection, especially in people with liver disease or weak immune systems.
For seasickness, keep the person on deck in fresh air, looking at the horizon.
